setting_label: 06:45 AM – The Quiet Floor, Observation Deck

panels.dialogue:
It isn't a malfunction, Sarah, A malfunction has entropy. 

This has... _syntax_

panels.narrative: The Mark on his palm was weeping more freely now, the blood tracing the Enochian sigils they had seen in the low-precision weights. The wound looked ancient, despite being only hours old. It was as if the hardware of his body was finally being upgraded to support a software it was always intended to run.

Sarah stepped closer and placed her left palm against his right. The sensation was not one of pain, but of a profound, terrifying completion—like two pieces of a broken seal being reunited. As their blood mingled, the sweet, metallic scent intensified, filling the Observation Deck until the air felt as thick as sacramental wine.
